_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
_goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

_filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

default: Paper and Plastic Board Games (First Win)

amazing_cpus.description: Setting this option to true will enable locations that require beating amazing-difficulty CPUs.

impossible_cpus.description: Setting this option to true will enable locations that require beating impossible-difficulty CPUs.

additional_checks.description: Setting this option to true will enable additional locations that have objectives other than completing a game or doing so with a specific difficulty.

game_guides.description: Setting this option to true will enable additional locations based on the existing Game Guides from the Guide Globe.

description: Use the following options to define the win condition types. Achieving each will provide a 'victory condition point', and you can later define how many of these you need to win.
**Overall:** Beat X number of different games.
**Major:** Complete enough games in each major category, where the condition for each can be defined individually.
**Minor:** Complete enough games in each minor category, where the condition for each can be defined individually.
**Items:** Obtain X number of mastery trophies from checks.

victory_condition_amount.display_name: Victory Condition: Amount Required For Victory
description: Define how many 'victory condition points' you need to win. Note that if this is larger than the number of victory conditions you have enabled above, generation will override this and set it to the number of enabled victory conditions.

If 'full', a game, its minor category and its major category must be found in order to be playable. If 'minor'/'major', a game and its minor/major category respectively must be found in order to be playable. If 'disabled', each game will be immediately playable upon being found.
If 'gate_categories' is not disabled, this determines how many copies of each minor/major category, as appropriate, are placed into the item pool.
Enable traps to complete various melodies on the piano. It is recommended, but not enforced, that this be disabled if Piano Checks is enabled.
Enable checks to complete various melodies on the piano. It is recommended, but not enforced, that this be disabled if Piano Traps is enabled.
If the win condition of this manual is to beat X number of different games, use this option to define the number of games required for victory.
If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each major category, use this option to define the number of board games required for satisfying this major category.
If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each major category, use this option to define the number of card games required for satisfying this major category.
If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each major category, use this option to define the number of sports games required for satisfying this major category.

If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each major category, use this option to define the number of variety and single-player games required for satisfying this major category.
If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each minor category, use this option to define the number of wooden games required for satisfying this minor category.

paper_plastic_board_games_required_for_v.display_name: Paper/Plastic Board Games Required for Victory
description: If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each minor category, use this option to define the number of paper or plastic board games required for satisfying this minor category.
If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each minor category, use this option to define the number of Japanese games required for satisfying this minor category.

non_japanese_card_games_required_for_vic.display_name: Non-Japanese Card Games Required for Victory
description: If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each minor category, use this option to define the number of non-Japanese card games required for satisfying this minor category.
If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each minor category, use this option to define the number of sophisticated games required for satisfying this minor category.
If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each minor category, use this option to define the number of toy games required for satisfying this minor category.
If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each minor category, use this option to define the number of variety games required for satisfying this minor category.
If the win condition of this manual is to complete enough games in each minor category, use this option to define the number of single-player games required for satisfying this minor category.
If the win condition of this manual is to obtain X number of mastery trophies from checks, use this option to define the number of trophies required for victory.
